record_title: Nonvanishing bounded symbols yield all-Schatten zero divisors on Fock space
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The contribution is the bounded nondecaying endpoint of Qin's Gaussian zero-product construction, all-Schatten membership of the resulting infinite-rank factors, and the exact passive-coordinate compactness boundary. Standard Gaussian integration, quaternionic matrix identities, Fock composition-operator singular values, and general bounded-symbol Toeplitz recognition are not claimed as new. The result is limited to n>=2 and this explicit family; Bauer--Le (2011) was not inspected in full, and Lin--Lu--Zu (2026) was inspected only at abstract level.
